req.title: Rate limit not enforced
req.statement: The system shall not throttle single-client request rates below 60/min.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-039 states the system shall NOT throttle single-client request rates below 60/min. This means 60 sequential requests within one minute must all return HTTP 2xx. Tests cover: (1) positive – exactly 60 requests all succeed (EP, exact-constant mutation kill); (2) boundary – 59 requests succeed (BVA, off-by-one below threshold); (3) boundary – 61 requests succeed (BVA, off-by-one above threshold); (4) negative – a single malformed request returns 4xx, confirming the error pathway is distinct from rate-limiting (NEG). All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient, pre-loaded DB rows, and exact status-code assertions to kill comparison-operator and constant mutations.

tests.name: test_sixty_requests_all_succeed_positive
preconditions: No external rate-limiting middleware is active
actions: Send exactly 60 GET /tasks/ requests sequentially using TestClient
expected: No response returns HTTP 429 or any 4xx/5xx
trace: R-TASK-039: system shall not throttle below 60/min
EP: 60 is the exact stated threshold; all must succeed
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r039_pos.db')
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

REQUIRED_LIMIT = 60
statuses = []
for _ in range(REQUIRED_LIMIT):
    r = client.get('/tasks/')
    statuses.append(r.status_code)

assert len(statuses) == 60
for i, code in enumerate(statuses):
    assert code == 200, f'Request {i+1} returned {code}, expected 200'

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)

def test_sixty_requests_all_succeed_positive():

tests.name: test_malformed_request_returns_4xx_not_throttle
actions: Send a POST /tasks/ with an empty title (violates min_length=1 schema constraint)
Inspect the response status code and body
expected: Response status code is 422 (Unprocessable Entity) — a client error, not a rate-limit error
Response is NOT 429 (rate limit) and NOT 200
trace: R-TASK-039 error pathway: HTTP 4xx on client error
NEG: distinguishes schema-validation 4xx from rate-limit 4xx; catches boolean-negation mutations on error-path branching
tests.executable:
import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r039_neg.db')
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': '', 'description': 'bad', 'completed': False})
assert r.status_code == 422, f'Expected 422, got {r.status_code}'
assert r.status_code != 200
assert r.status_code != 429

body = r.json()
assert 'detail' in body

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)

tests.name: test_mixed_endpoints_sixty_requests_all_succeed
actions: Send 60 requests alternating between GET /tasks/ and GET /tasks/1
trace: R-TASK-039: rate limit applies to single-client across endpoints
DT: decision table covers multiple endpoint combinations within the 60/min window
tests.executable:
import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r039_dt.db')
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

REQUIRED_LIMIT = 60
statuses = []
for i in range(REQUIRED_LIMIT):
    if i % 2 == 0:
        r = client.get('/tasks/')
    else:
        r = client.get('/tasks/1')
    statuses.append(r.status_code)

assert len(statuses) == 60
for i, code in enumerate(statuses):
    assert code == 200, f'Request {i+1} returned {code}, expected 200'

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)

def test_mixed_endpoints_sixty_requests_all_succeed():
    pass
